name: ITSM-Agentic: Azure Create Resource Group (az cli) - Worker1OL

nodes.name: Generate Unique Resource Group Name
nodes.notes: New name every run (timestamp + random suffix) so repeat executions never collide with a resource group left over from a previous run.

nodes.name: Create Azure Resource Group (SSH)
nodes.notes: Runs `az group create` on Worker1OL. Assumes the SSH user is already logged in via `az login` (or uses a managed identity / service principal already configured in its az cli context) -- this workflow does not handle Azure auth.
